subjects.prompt: a Wick Brood, one clotted heap of fist-sized rounded amber tallow bodies fused together at their flanks into a single low mass, a loose net of dark wet peat-flesh strands binding it, each rounded body tipped with a small charred black stub, small dull round amber spots set low in the leading bodies, slow amber drips setting along its base, resting on flat wet peat at a three-quarter angle, colours peat black-brown, bog green, tallow gold, pale misty background

a Wick Brood close at hand, a fused heap of rounded amber tallow bodies joined at their flanks and held in a sagging net of dark wet fibre strands, charred black stubs tipping the upper bodies, dull amber spots in the leading bodies, one heavy slow pour of amber wax running off its front edge and pooling on the flat wet peat beneath, colours peat black-brown, bog green, tallow gold, dark misty background
